verdict.rationale: A sandbox or staging environment is a fair question for a cloud editor and hosting platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no isolated sandbox or test environment that keeps production data safe. Checkpoints (snapshot and rollback) and project archive/restore are recovery features, not sandbox isolation, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
